_comment: Job 028's new-key namespace (`app`, see i18n/i18n.ts). Holds English text for UI genuinely novel to THIS reimplementation, with no reasonable analogue in the closed-source original's own ~600-key string table (`resources/languages/translations/en-US.json`, loaded into the default `translation` namespace unmodified) — per jobs/028-i18n.md's reuse-vs-new-key judgement call. See that job's Handoff notes for the full list of what landed here and why. Only en-US exists for this namespace: i18next's `fallbackLng` sends every other locale here too, since translating app-original text is out of scope for this job (see jobs/028-i18n.md 'Out of scope').

canvas.generateFactoryBasicModeWarning: Basic mode assumes even splits, so this factory's uneven splits may falsely show as mismatched. Switch to Full mode.
canvas.generateFactoryPriorityBalancedDe: Prefers the recipe with the fewest production steps, falling back to the standard (non-alternate) recipe on a tie.
canvas.generateFactoryPriorityFewestMach: Minimizes the total number of machines needed across the whole factory.
canvas.generateFactoryPriorityFewestRawR: Minimizes total raw ore/resource extraction, even if it takes an extra processing step.
canvas.generateFactoryPrioritySimplestCh: Minimizes the number of machines and connections in the result, favoring shorter chains with fewer inputs.
canvas.generateFactoryPriorityLowestPowe: Minimizes total power (MW) consumed by the generated machines.
canvas.generateFactoryUseConvertersTitle: Allow recipes that run on the Converter machine (ore-to-ore conversions) — off by default since they're a late-game, resource-intensive mechanic most factories don't need. Still used automatically when a part has no other recipe, or when it's clearly the intended route for a part already at or above the Converter's own tier.
canvas.generateFactoryHandleByproductsTi: Reuse leftover byproducts (secondary recipe outputs with nowhere else to go) to cut back raw extraction where possible, then route whatever's left through a conversion machine into something else (or, for a fluid/gas, packaged first) before sinking it — on by default; uncheck to leave byproduct outputs unrouted instead.
canvas.generateFactoryByproductUnsinkabl: no packaging route found — left disconnected
canvas.generateFactoryRouteToDepotTitle: Connect each produced item to its own Dimensional Depot Uploader, limited to the requested rate — on by default; uncheck to leave outputs with their normal open port instead. Fluids and gases can't use a Depot (solid items only) and are always left unrouted; each Depot only ever holds one item type.
canvas.generateFactoryDepotFluidWarning: {{parts}} can't use a Depot — fluids/gases aren't eligible.
